known_gap: The first eight events (sensor pass, first floor hit) match beat for beat. After that the block's first bounce differs: Rapier applies restitution once per contact at the end of a step (box2d style), so a box landing flat on its four corners picks up about 6 rad/s of spin and climbs back into the sensor at beat 28; Roblox's block bounces straight. Fix needs our own restitution pass or Roblox-like contact solving (next milestone).
